description: Export the checkpoint screenshot with visual differences highlighted in pink, cropped to `rect` if provided. Returns a file path — pass it directly to the Read tool to view the image. Pad a changed-area rect by 10px on every side before requesting it here; the region may exceed the image bounds, which is fine. Already reflects any match regions added during resolution — a masked area is no longer highlighted. Resolution can happen between calls, so never reuse an earlier result in this conversation — call it again.

rect.description: Optional crop/filter rectangle in pixels. Use image sizes from eyes_inspect_steps to construct it (e.g. top quarter of a 1020×600 image = {left:0,top:0,width:1020,height:150}).

sessionUrl.description: Eyes session URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/{sessionId}[/steps/{N}]?accountId=... (the /steps/N suffix is ignored if present)

stepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the step, as returned by eyes_inspect_steps

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_inspect_image_diff
